Bottle Caps Game

Toss, scatter and flick five flattened bottle caps.

How we play

  1. Five caps. Swipe up to toss them and catch them on the back of your hand. Catch 3 or more and the tosser strikes first; otherwise the opponent does. (Local game: Player 1 tosses for both.)
  2. The first striker scatters the caps. After that they stay where they lie and bounce off the table rim.
  3. The opponent marks one cap with a ring. That is the target.
  4. The striker picks any other cap, drags back from it to aim and set strength, then lets go.
  5. Clean hit = your cap touches the target and no other cap is touched or moved. 1 point. If the target overlaps another cap: Tindih = 2 points; three or more in an overlapping chain: Tindih berantai = 3 points.
  6. After a clean hit you strike again and your opponent marks a new target. A miss, or touching or moving any other cap, ends your turn.
  7. First to 7 points wins. Guided practice has no opponent: a miss just lets you try again.
BottleCap rules differ between places and playgrounds. These are the rules this game uses.
